answer: Velvet Lagoon Consistency Rule Each agent must maintain behavioral continuity across epochs by referencing a unique relic from their prior epoch’s final state. This relic—a cryptographically anchored hash of valid actions—must be presented upon joining the next epoch. The system verifies relic authenticity against a public ledger of epoch transitions. An attacker attempting to spawn clones must generate plausible relics for each fake identity, requiring full replay of prior epoch logic under identical conditions.
